hypothesis: Sensor-attribute preservation is behavior-neutral across complete real recordings, not only no-obstacle prefixes.

criterion.discrete: All non-timing statuses, objects, IDs, integer support counts, confirmation flags, evidence timestamps and list order must agree; any mismatch is investigated.
criterion.numeric: Report every unequal numeric leaf; absolute/relative tolerance 1e-9 is declared before replay for continuous floating estimates only. IDs, counters, flags and source timestamps must be exact.
criterion.coverage: Every emitted unique measurement until EOF from all nine configured bags. Require manifests and ingestion counts; no intersection-of-frames-only acceptance. Report actual state coverage and unsupported cases.
criterion.diagnostics: All legacy arrays byte-identical; exact original-slot/value/valid-mask alignment for saved diagnostic representative stages.
criterion.resources: Measure processing/decode/wall and cumulative process peak RSS for sequential same-machine runs; report regressions honestly without asserting field latency or recall.
